# Generated by ppc finalize (construction_plan_country.py) from [construction_plan_country]; do not edit by hand.

# Location scope (an owned location in pp_cplan_run): the Towns and Buildings group may start a construction
# here: not a location that is only conquered, no profile here that switched the group off (pp_lprof_xc), and
# nothing under construction (pp_cplan_site_free: a location builds one at a time).
pp_cplan_country_site = {
	NOT = { integration_level = conquered }
	NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_xc }
	pp_cplan_site_free = yes
}

# Location scope: the urban rights rule may grant a right here: not only conquered, no profile here that switched
# the group off, room for one more right, and none granted here this month.
pp_cplan_country_rights_site = {
	NOT = { integration_level = conquered }
	NOT = { has_variable = pp_lprof_xc }
	NOT = { has_variable = pp_cplan_right_mark }
	has_max_town_rights = no
}

# Building scope: a standing, open building the country can upgrade (its successor is researched: in game
# 2026-11-10 building_can_be_upgraded_by is true on every standing older tier from then on). A closed building is
# left alone: whoever closed it found it does not pay.
pp_cplan_country_upgradable = {
	building_level > 0
	is_opened = yes
	building_can_be_upgraded_by = scope:pp_cplan_country
}

# ---- Town and city upgrades (location scope): the market holds the upgrade's construction goods ----
# 12 months of the draw of every good of the rank's construction demand, the rule the plan's buildings
# follow (pp_cplan_goods_here_<demand>, written by construction_plan.py for the buildings' demands only): an
# upgrade stalls without its goods like any construction (in game 2026-11-10: 90 of 365 days after a year in a
# market short of masonry) and holds the location's construction slot meanwhile.
pp_cplan_country_goods_town = {
	market ?= { "stockpile_in_market(goods:glass)" >= 12 "stockpile_in_market(goods:lumber)" >= 12 "stockpile_in_market(goods:masonry)" >= 24 }
}
pp_cplan_country_goods_city = {
	market ?= { "stockpile_in_market(goods:glass)" >= 24 "stockpile_in_market(goods:lumber)" >= 24 "stockpile_in_market(goods:masonry)" >= 48 }
}

# ---- Public buildings (location scope): where the rule builds the building ----
# A booster (its modifier does nothing but raise goods' output in its location) is built only where the location
# makes one of those goods: its raw material is the good, or a standing building there produces it (the Location
# Plan's "made here"). Every other public building: anywhere.
pp_cplan_pub_anywhere = {
	always = yes
}
pp_cplan_pub_where_sawmill = {
	OR = {
		raw_material ?= goods:lumber
		any_buildings_in_location = {
			building_level > 0
			OR = {
				building_produced_goods = goods:lumber
			}
		}
	}
}
pp_cplan_pub_where_windmill = {
	OR = {
		raw_material ?= goods:wheat
		raw_material ?= goods:rice
		raw_material ?= goods:millet
		any_buildings_in_location = {
			building_level > 0
			OR = {
				building_produced_goods = goods:wheat
				building_produced_goods = goods:rice
				building_produced_goods = goods:millet
			}
		}
	}
}
pp_cplan_pub_where_local_smelters = {

		raw_material ?= goods:iron
		raw_material ?= goods:copper
		raw_material ?= goods:tin
		raw_material ?= goods:lead
		any_buildings_in_location = {
			building_level > 0
			OR = {
				building_produced_goods = goods:iron
				building_produced_goods = goods:copper
				building_produced_goods = goods:tin
				building_produced_goods = goods:lead
			}
		}
	}
}

# ---- Urban rights ----
# Per right, from the game's town rights files in load order (a later definition replaces, an inject adds):
#   pp_cplan_right_potential_<key>  country scope: the right's potential as written (root = the country), and one
#                                   of the advances that unlock it (unlock_town_rights) where any does;
#   pp_cplan_right_allow_<key>      country scope, scope:target = the location: the right's allow as written;
#   pp_cplan_right_site_<key>       location scope: the location does not hold the right, nor the charter that
#                                   upgrades into it (the plan does not upgrade), nor the right it upgrades into.

pp_cplan_right_potential_flemish_cloth_industries_right = {
	has_advance = flemish_cloth_making
}
pp_cplan_right_allow_flemish_cloth_industries_right = {
	scope:target = { NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights } }
}
pp_cplan_right_site_flemish_cloth_industries_right = {
	NOR = {
		has_town_rights = town_rights_type:flemish_cloth_industries_right
	}
}

pp_cplan_right_potential_scandinavian_bergslag_privileges = {
	has_advance = scandinavian_bergslag_privileges_advance
}
pp_cplan_right_allow_scandinavian_bergslag_privileges = {
	scope:target = {
		NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights }
		NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:mining_charter }
		OR = {
			raw_material = goods:iron
			raw_material = goods:copper
			raw_material = goods:silver
			raw_material = goods:lead
		}
	}
}
pp_cplan_right_site_scandinavian_bergslag_privileges = {
	NOR = {
		has_town_rights = town_rights_type:scandinavian_bergslag_privileges
	}
}

			text = constantinopolitan_silk_monopoly_rights_tt

	}

		has_or_had_tag = LON
		has_or_had_tag = CAS
	}
}

	scope:target = {
		OR = {
			area = area:leon_area
			area = area:extremadura_area
			area = area:toledo_area
			area = area:murcia_area
			dominant_culture = culture:leonese
		}
		NOR = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:foros_extensos_town_rights
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:fuero_real_town_rights
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:fuero_general_town_rights
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:fuero_de_aragon_town_rights
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:usatges_de_barcelona_town_rights
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:furs_de_valencia_town_rights
		}
	}
}

pp_cplan_right_potential_ara_consulate_sea_town_rights = {
	modifier:unlocked_consulate_sea_town_right = yes
}
pp_cplan_right_allow_ara_consulate_sea_town_rights = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = consulate_sea_no_province_has_the_town_right
		NOT = {
			scope:target = {
				region = {
					any_location_in_region = {
						owner ?= scope:target.owner
						has_town_rights = town_rights_type:ara_consulate_sea_town_rights
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
pp_cplan_right_site_ara_consulate_sea_town_rights = {
	NOR = {
		has_town_rights = town_rights_type:ara_consulate_sea_town_rights
	}
}

pp_cplan_right_potential_imperial_breadbasket_rights = {
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = BYZ
		has_or_had_tag = ROM
	}
}
pp_cplan_right_allow_imperial_breadbasket_rights = {
	scope:target = {
		NOT = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:granary_town }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = imperial_breadbasket_rights_rank_tt
			OR = {
				location_rank = location_rank:city
				location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = imperial_breadbasket_rights_granary_tt
			any_buildings_in_location = {
				building_type = building_type:granary
				building_level >= 5
			}
		}
	}
}
pp_cplan_right_site_imperial_breadbasket_rights = {
	NOR = {
		has_town_rights = town_rights_type:imperial_breadbasket_rights
	}
}

pp_cplan_right_potential_scholai_literacy_rights = {
	OR = {
		culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
		culture_group_percentage_in_country = {
			culture_group = culture_group:greek_group
			value > 0.25
		}
	}
}
pp_cplan_right_allow_scholai_literacy_rights = {
	scope:target = {
		dominant_culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
		has_building = building_type:university
		development >= 20
	}
}
pp_cplan_right_site_scholai_literacy_rights = {
	NOR = {
		has_town_rights = town_rights_type:scholai_literacy_rights
	}
}

pp_cplan_right_potential_municipia_privilegia = {
	has_dlc = "d008_fate_of_the_phoenix"
	OR = {
		has_or_had_tag = BYZ
		has_or_had_tag = ROM
	}
}
pp_cplan_right_allow_municipia_privilegia = {
	custom_tooltip = {
		text = municipia_privilegia_latin_tt
		scope:target.owner = {
			OR = {
				societal_value:latinization_vs_hellenization < -50
				court_language = language:latin_language
				dominant_language = language:latin_language
			}
		}
	}
}
pp_cplan_right_site_municipia_privilegia = {
	NOR = {
		has_town_rights = town_rights_type:municipia_privilegia
	}
}
